The organizations that own your projects: list, create, rename and delete them.

Usage:
  voidhash org <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  org, orgs

Commands:
  list       List the organizations you belong to and their projects.
  create     Create an organization, with you as its owner.
  edit       Rename an organization or change its logo.
  delete     Delete an organization with its projects and all their data.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash org <command> --help' for more about a command.
